FAIL_TO_PASS: nested-this-expressions: properly keep or ignore nested "this"-expressions
property-read-side-effects: allows disabling side-effects when accessing properties
array-elements: tracks elements of arrays
inlined-namespace-static-resolution: statically resolves Symbol.toStringTag for inlined namespaces
unmodified-default-exports-function-argument: passing unbound default export to function cannot rebind it
break-statement-loops: breaks control flow when a break statement is encountered inside a loop
smallest: handles treeshake preset "smallest"
unused-parameters: removes arguments that correspond to unused parameters
side-effects-getters-and-setters: treat getters and setters as function calls
side-effects-this: When a constructor is called with the new keyword, changing its this has no side effects
side-effects-generators: Properly detect side-effects in generator functions
side-effects-es6-class-expressions: determine side effects in ES6 class expressions
declarations-with-side-effects: retains side-effects in declarations will tree-shaking the declared variable
return-expressions: Track side-effects of method return values
can-import-self-treeshake: direct self import
preset-with-override: allows using the "preset" option with overrides
literals-from-return-expressions: tracks literal values across return expressions
chained-assignments: treeshakes chained assignments
remove-no-side-effects-variable: removes __NO_SIDE_EFFECTS__ annotation if the variable declaration is only removed partially
supports-es5-shim: supports es5-shim
